newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai sees big increase in mobile phones.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai sees big increase in mobile phones.

text.p: The number of mobile phone users in Shanghai has jumped to 300,000 from 10,000 in 1992, the Liberation Daily newspaper said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said Shanghai, the biggest mobile phone market in China, was expected to have 800,000 of the portables in use by the end of 1997.

Meanwhile, the official Xinhua news agency said a survey of mobile phone users in Shanghai had indicated that only 29.5 percent of mobile phones were now bought by companies for their staff with almost all now sold to individuals.
The agency said mobile phones were no longer considered to be a status symbol in the city, but had become simply a useful tool of communication.
